sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 1)

purpose.zh: 练腋下肋骨边上那块肌肉，单手撑地时肩不塌
purpose.en: Trains the muscle along the side of your ribs so your shoulder holds up on one hand.

text.zh: 手肘锁死别弯，只让肩胛骨动
text.en: Lock your elbows, only your shoulder blades move

text.zh: 胸口往地上沉一点，两块肩胛骨靠拢；再用手把地推开，推到后背微微拱起。
text.en: Let your chest drop a little so your shoulder blades come together, then push the floor away until your upper back rounds slightly.

text.zh: 推到最高别急着落，停一秒，腋下那块会发酸。
text.en: At the highest point, wait a second. You should feel it under your armpits.

text.zh: 从头到脚跟一块板，屁股别跟着肩上下晃。
text.en: Head to heels stays one plank; your hips shouldn't bob with your shoulders.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘弯了，变成普通俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows and turning it into a regular push-up.
Shrugging and pushing your head forward.

commonErrors.zh: 塌腰，或者靠拱背、塌背假装肩胛骨在动
commonErrors.en: Sagging your lower back, or rounding and arching your back while the shoulder blades stay put.

cautions.zh: 推起来肩前侧疼就先跪着做
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder hurts, do it on your knees.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (4 s per rep, 1 s at the top; brief: 顶端停 1 秒)

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 10 第一侧移重 / 14 第二侧移重
thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面（看肩胛下沉与推开）＋斜后上方（看背部拱起）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 3 组 × 10–12 次，休 60 秒；顶端停 1 秒
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 4 s (push 1.5 s, top 1 s, sink 1.3 s, 0.2 s at the bottom).

reminders.en: Elbows locked, only shoulder blades move

reminders.zh: 肩离耳朵远，头别往前探
reminders.en: Shoulders away from ears, head in line
